hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Overlap
hints.text: A substring of length m differs from pattern by at most 1 character if and only if their common prefix length plus common suffix length is at least m - 1.

hints.title: Forward and Backward Z-Arrays
hints.text: Compute the Z-function on pattern + s to find longest common prefixes. Compute the Z-function on reversed(pattern) + reversed(s) to find longest common suffixes.

hints.title: Earliest Index Verification
hints.text: Iterate starting index i from 0 to n - m. Check if common_prefix + common_suffix >= m - 1. Return the first matching index i.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Z-algorithm runs in linear time for both forward and reverse strings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(|s| * |pattern|) brute-force character comparisons time out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(|s| + |pattern|) space to hold the concatenated Z-arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies Z-algorithm or string hashing to compute LCP and LCS in linear time.
